android.desc:
MotoSync+ is dedicated to helping families protect their digital lives while maintaining the speed and performance needed for households with multiple devices. Motorola routers provide robust internet security, safeguarding home networks from hackers, malware, and other online threats with Advanced Internet Protection. The intuitive parental controls, accessible through the MotoSync+ mobile app, make it easy for parents to monitor their children’s online activity and set healthy boundaries on screen time.

Benefits:
 - Quick installation (under 10 minutes)
 - Ultra-fast, reliable connection
 - Comprehensive network security
 - Powerful parental controls
 - Built-in content filtering
 - Customizable profiles for each child
 - Real-time request and approval feature
 - Screen time management tools
 - App-specific controls for popular platforms like Snapchat, YouTube, and Instagram
 - Visual browsing history—even if it’s deleted from the browser
 - Network-level protection against malware and ransomware
 - Device management options
 - Traffic prioritization for optimal performance
 - Upgrade to get protection on the go, where you extend your parental controls & security for up to x5 smartphones when away from home.
 - With MotoSync+, you can enjoy peace of mind knowing your home network is safe, secure, and optimized for your family’s needs.

********************************************************************************

MotoSync+ currently supports the MQ20, MNQ1525, and MG8702.

quotes.text:
According to Google Play reviews for the MotoSync+ app, this issue is

   due to server license expiring, after the host ended operations and
   has been in play since at least May 12

A June 4th review says this:

    The latest issue is "Server Licence Expired". I have been
    unable to manage devices for months. So..I reset my router.
    I no longer have a mesh network. I have only the single
    point router and still unable to manage devices. 
    The licence verification issue continues. I found out this
    is because a 3rd party managed the Server and folded. 
    3 weeks of almost daily Chat promises to connect to a
    specialist which never materializes. 
    I left some chats open for hours.

https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.motosyncplus.mobile&hl=en_US
quotes.story_title: Motorola effectively bricked its entire line of WiFi routers without explanation
